source: BattleShips Pro v1.187 object data + JASS, multi-agent audit pass 2

items.name: Light Sail
items.effects: +10% move speed (self-only Endurance Aura, aare=1, atar=self); attack speed bonus Oae2=0 (none). Non-stackable.
items.provenance: Oae1: wc3-default (Endurance Aura L1 = 10% move speed, liquipedia.net/warcraft/Endurance_Aura; corroborated by map tooltip 'Sail Speed Bonus: 10%'). Oae2/area/targets: objectdata (A03X).
items.special: Only sail whose Oae1 is not overridden at level 1 — live value comes from the WC3 base-ability default.

items.name: Great Sail
items.effects: +25% move speed (Oae1=0.25); no attack-speed bonus (Oae2=0). Non-stackable.

items.name: Goblin Sail
items.effects: +50% move speed (Oae1=0.5); no attack-speed bonus (Oae2=0). Non-stackable.

items.name: Royal Sail
items.effects: +75% move speed (Oae1=0.75); no attack-speed bonus (Oae2=0). Non-stackable.

items.name: Silk Sail
items.effects: +100% move speed (Oae1=1.0); no attack-speed bonus (Oae2=0). Non-stackable.

items.name: Outboard Propeller
items.effects: +200% move speed (Oae1=2.0); no attack-speed bonus (Oae2=0). Non-stackable.

items.name: Stone Hull
items.effects: +100 max HP (A00E AIlf Ilif=100); 10% damage reduction (A03A AIsr isr2=0.10); -5% move speed (A040 AOae Oae1=-0.05, Oae2=0); +3 armor (AId3, unmodified stock). Non-stackable.
items.provenance: HP/reduction/speed: objectdata; armor: wc3-default (AId3 = Item Armor Bonus +3; AIdN=+N stock convention, corroborated by this map's own AId5(+5->6) and AId8(+8->9) overrides). Tooltip claims '+6%' armor — tooltip-only, conflicts with object data.
items.special: DISCREPANCY: tooltip says Armor Bonus +6, but AId3 is NOT overridden in abilities.json (the map overrode AId5 and AId8 but not AId3) -> live value +3. AIsr is the Runed-Bracers-type reduction (reduces spell damage in stock WC3; the map's weapons are Phoenix-Fire/spell-damage based, so it applies to them).

items.name: Bronze Hull
items.effects: +250 max HP (Ilif=250); 20% damage reduction (isr2=0.20); -10% move speed (Oae1=-0.10); +6 armor (AId5 overridden Idef=6). Non-stackable.
items.provenance: objectdata (A00F/A02G/A041/AId5) — all four stats explicit; matches tooltip exactly.

items.name: Gold Hull
items.effects: +500 max HP (Ilif=500); 30% damage reduction (isr2=0.30); -20% move speed (Oae1=-0.20); +9 armor (AId8 overridden Idef=9). Non-stackable.

items.name: Kraken shell
items.effects: +20 HP/sec regeneration (A044 Arel Ihpr=20); 20% damage reduction (A052 AIsr isr2=0.20); +30% move speed (A051 AOae Oae1=0.30, Oae2=0); +6 armor (AId5 Idef=6). Non-stackable.
items.special: Tooltip carries the boilerplate 'Submarines may not carry this item' note, but the map script's sub whitelist explicitly allows Kraken shell on submarines (per orchestrator rule). Hybrid hull: only hull with no HP bonus and no speed penalty.

items.name: Repair Crew
items.effects: +2 HP/sec passive repair while sailing.
items.provenance: Ihpr: wc3-default (Arel Item Life Regeneration base = 2 HP/sec, the Ring of Regeneration value, liquipedia.net/warcraft/Ring_of_Regeneration; A00G overrides only name/icon, no Ihpr at L1; corroborated by map tooltip 'Hit points / second: 2').
items.special: Submarines may not carry (tooltip note).

items.name: Goblin Mechanic
items.effects: Active (Rejuvenation-based A04I/Arej): repairs a friendly mechanical/structure target for 2500 HP over 20 s (Rej1=2500, adur=20); cast range 100; 0 mana. 1 charge, perishable.
items.special: Trade item — removed if dropped or given away; gold 2 is the trade-good price.

items.name: Goblin Engineer
items.effects: Active (A056/Arej): repairs a friendly mechanical/structure target for 3750 HP over 20 s (Rej1=3750, adur=20); cast range 100; 0 mana. 1 charge, perishable.
items.special: Trade item — removed if dropped or given away.

items.name: GrandMaster Craftsman
items.effects: Active (A030/Arej): repairs a friendly mechanical/structure target for 20000 HP over 20 s (Rej1=20000, adur=20) — effectively a complete building repair; cast range 100; 0 mana. 1 charge, perishable.
items.provenance: objectdata; tooltip says 'Completely repairs an allied building'.
items.special: Shop restock delay 1200 s (isst).

items.name: Weak Repair Wood

items.name: Smoke Machine
items.effects: On use: ship becomes invisible for 10 s (A034 base AIv1, adur/ahdu=10); cooldown 70 s; endless charges; applies buff B00I.
items.provenance: duration/cooldown: objectdata; break conditions: wc3-default (standard WC3 invisibility — broken when the unit attacks, casts, or uses an item; classic.battle.net invisibility basics).

items.name: Integrated Smoke Machine
items.effects: On use: ship becomes invisible for 30 s (A02Y base AIv1, adur=30); cooldown 240 s; endless charges; buff B00I.
items.provenance: duration/cooldown: objectdata; break conditions: wc3-default invisibility.
items.special: The Merchant Ship has a separate unit-ability version (modified stock Aivs, also 30 s / 240 s).

items.name: Light Teleporter
items.effects: On use: Blink (A035 base AEbl) — max distance 1200 (Ebl1=1200), min distance 0 (Ebl2=0); cooldown 50 s; 0 mana (amcs=0); endless charges.
items.provenance: objectdata (all key fields overridden); matches tooltip.
items.special: Tooltip: 'Can only target shallow water' — enforced by terrain/trigger, not object data.

items.name: Spies
items.effects: 4 charges (iuse=4). Each use summons a stationary 'Spy' ward (unit nvil) at target point for 540 s (modified stock AIff: Ist1=nvil, adur=540, cooldown 0). Spy: invulnerable (Avul), True Sight / detects invisible (Atru), 1600 sight day & night, move speed 0, visible (Shade model).
items.provenance: summon unit/duration/cooldown/charges + nvil stats: objectdata; base item is stock 'totw' Talisman of the Wild (default 3 charges, summons 1 Furbolg 180 s — forum.wc3edit.net rawcode list + liquipedia.net/warcraft/Talisman_of_the_Wild), retargeted by the map.
items.special: Tooltip: 'Spies are visable, but invulnerable.' Identical clones: I020/I024/I025/totw (one per shop).

items.special: Clone of I020.

items.name: Informant
items.effects: Targeted reveal (stock Ashs Shadow Sight, modified): cast range 99999 (global), can target any enemy unit including invulnerable ones (atar=air,enemies,ground,invulnerable,vulnerable); applies Shadow Sight buff giving vision of the target. Unlimited uses (iuse=0, iper=0, non-perishable) and ignores cooldown (iicd=1).
items.provenance: range/targets/charges/cooldown: objectdata; reveal duration: wc3-default (Ashs duration NOT overridden; stock value could not be confirmed from authoritative sources — campaign-only item, no liquipedia page; recommend treating as long-duration/until-dispelled buff reveal and verifying in-game).
items.special: UNRESOLVED: exact stock Shadow Sight buff duration. Base item: stock 'wshs' Wand of Shadowsight (wc3edit rawcode list).

items.name: Sentry Ward
items.effects: 1 charge. Drops an invisible, invulnerable Sentry Ward that watches an area for 540 s (modified stock AIsw adur=540). Ward detects invisible units (true sight).
items.provenance: duration/charges/gold: objectdata; true sight + ward vision: wc3-default (stock AIsw/oeye ward not otherwise modified; classic.battle.net heroitemscharged: 'Sentry Wards can be used to reveal invisible units'; ward sight ~1600 in 1.20-era data, modern liquipedia lists 1200).
items.special: icid='Aeye' — shares a cooldown group with the other ward items. Item name not overridden (stock 'Sentry Wards'); map tooltip says 'Drops a Sentry Ward to spy upon an area for 540 seconds... Is Invisible and Invunerable.' Clones: I021/I022/I023/wswd.

items.name: Motion Detectors
items.effects: 5 charges (iuse=5). Drops a 'Motion Detector' ward (unit ohwd): invulnerable + permanently invisible (Avul+Agho), sight radius 1 (provides no vision itself), tiny wisp model. The stock Healing Ward aura buff is removed (AIhw abuf=''), so it heals nothing — its only function is the proximity warning ('warns you if any enemy units enter nearby'), which is trigger-driven.
items.provenance: charges/ward unit stats/cleared heal buff: objectdata; ward lifetime: wc3-default (AIhw duration not overridden; stock item Healing Ward lasts ~20 s per classic.battle.net heroitemscharged — UNCERTAIN, likely trigger-managed in this map). No gold cost in object data (price possibly trigger/shop-set).
items.special: Repurposed stock 'whwd' Healing Wards item. Warning behavior cannot be derived from object data — implement from map script.

items.name: Flare Gun
items.effects: Reveals a target area of the map: radius 1200 (aare), reveal lasts 15 s (adur), cooldown 60 s (modified stock AIfa). Unlimited charges (iuse=0, iper=0, isto=1).
items.provenance: radius/duration/cooldown/charges: objectdata; base = stock 'fgun' Flare Gun item (wc3edit rawcode list). Whether the flare detects invisible units was not confirmed — wc3-default flare behavior, verify in-game.
items.special: Three price variants exist (different shops): fgun 485g, I028 425g, I029 510g.

items.name: Leviathian Charm
items.effects: Summons a 'Leviathian' (unit nba2) to fight for you for 1200 s (modified stock AIfu: adur=1200, cooldown 0). 1 charge. Leviathian: 8500 HP, +7 HP/s regen, mechanical, 'fort' defense type, siege attack (range 1000, splash missile), move speed 140, sight 1800, food 0, abilities A04U/A04V/A04T/A04N/A04L (includes Eat Hero per tooltip).
items.provenance: duration/cooldown/unit stats: objectdata; charges: wc3-default (stock 'fgdg' Demonic Figurine = 1 charge, summons Doom Guard (Summoned) i.e. unit nba2 — liquipedia.net/warcraft/Demonic_Figurine; map renamed nba2 to Leviathian).
items.special: Shop restock delay 300 s (isst). Summon's exact attack damage fields are partially zeroed in object data (ua1b=0) — damage likely handled by its custom abilities; verify against the weapons agent's A04* analysis if needed.

items.provenance: iabi cleared: objectdata; music playback: trigger-driven (tooltip-only). Base = stock 'tst2' Tome of Strength +2 (wc3edit rawcode list) with the strength ability removed.
